title: Grilled Australian White Yam Skewers
description: A light and rich Australian dish featuring white yam, grilled to perfection with a Mediterranean twist, perfect for a snack or side dish. The robata-grill adds a smoky flavor to the yam and herbs.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat, about 200 degrees Celsius.
Thread the white yam cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the yam cubes.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the yam is tender and lightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
